reviews.comment: Take this class!! Prof Chester is a great guy, very passionate, and very understanding. 40% of the grade is attendance, no homework, has review sessions, and he provides a “practice exam” before each exam which contains about 1/3 of the test questions. This should be an easy A as long as u look over the material.

For GEOL101. 40% of your grade was just completion of worksheets given in class. You can tell he's passionate about the subject but the slides aren't as detailed compared to exam questions and some concepts weren't explained well. For my notes I combined what he said during lectures and AI to ensure I understood the content.

GEOL 101. I really liked this professor, most people talked over him so I felt bad because he is passionate about what he does. He had some cool demonstrations towards the middle of the semester. This class is an easy A. Grade consists of almost daily lecture assignments but they're a completion grade and there are three in class tests, NO FINAL!

GEOL 101. Hard to stay awake and pay attention to him. ALL of the content is in the lecture during class. Attendance is not technically required, but all assignments are done and turned in during class. Go to the review sessions, study the practice exams, (he takes them from the actual test), you should be fine.

Chester is a very intelligent professor and knows a lot about the subject of geology. That being said, he makes the class incredibly difficult. I took this class as a directed elective and found myself surrounded by petroleum engineers in both my lecture and lab classes. DO NOT take this class is you aren't passionate about Geology.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Chester is extremely passionate about geology, which you can tell by his extensive knowledge during lecture to specific exam questions. Lectures can sometimes be hard to stay focused the whole time. Exams are all FRQ, so if you don't study you will definitely not pass. I did well by studying past exams he gives and reading the textbook.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Chester is passionate about geology, but there's no point in making an easy class so difficult, especially for people who need to take this class with no intentions towards geology. Definitely take someone else if you can, Chester will make your semester twice as hard. If he's the only one teaching it that semester, try to wait for a better prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: For a 100 level class this one was rather difficult. Definitely recommend reading the text book and doing past exams. He is very passionate about geology, which shows on his tests because they are very specific.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Good prof. Material can be dry but he's funny and very knowledgeable. Exams are all paragraph free response type Qs. Provides previous exams. I had very good results by simply reading the textbook and reviewing past exams. No HW. In-class assignments on random days. Lab isn't very difficult and only requires you to read maybe 20 pages a week.

Chester is a good teacher, has his funny moments, and really cares about the subject. The main problems with him are the boring and drawn out lectures, and the extremely specific tests. All he does is read from slides. Read the book, do the outlines, and go through the powerpoints and you should be fine.

His tests are so specific and he expects you to know so much material. It is very hard to listen to him lecture because he just makes things really boring. Yes the study guides will help you but you have to dig through the textbook for answers. This class takes up a lot of your time. Don't take it if possible.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Chester is a professor that truly cares about the understanding of the material rather than just memorizing it. Which can make the course somewhat difficult given that tests are all free response. But Chester will curve if the average is low which is good. Would recommend if willing to work.

Dr. Chester gets a bad reputation because his tests are difficult.  However, this is not the case.  He tests you about 70% on understanding the material and 30% on memorization.  If you work hard, do all the study guide HE PROVIDES, and try to gain a deep understanding for the material, you will do very well.  His lectures were sometimes very long.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof. Chester was an AWESOME professor. I took his class in 2000 and I still remember how he demonstrated the fault line with the entire lecture hall as the guinea pigs. He seemed nice and was fun to listen to. I enjoyed his class.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Chester is a decent prof.  He gives you detailed study guides, and there aren't any surprises on the tests.  He gave us 5 point curves on the exams.  Lectures aren't thrilling.  If you want a good grade, read the book.  It covers the same material as his lectures.  The one time I emailed him he responded right away.   The lab can be tough.

He is a tough prof, but he cares about you learning the material. Always makes himself available for questions and help. Gives good study guides. Tests you over exactly what he lectures you and tells you to know about. Put in the work and you wont get less than a B.

Lectures: Feel long cuz he talks a lot, goes off tangent often and mutters, but he's a nice guy, skipping a few classes won't hurt Tests: Free response, pretty tough, expect diagrams, don't underesetimate Lab: blow off, finished quickly Studying: book good for referencing, he provides study guides which are VERY HELPFUL, pay att to powerpoints

The biggest issue with Dr. Chester's class is his exams: 3, all entirely free-response essay/reproduce the diagram. He doesn't test your understanding of geology but rather your ability to memorize the textbook. Lectures are fairly dry, you need to attend for in-class activities. The lab portion is interesting & fun! Avoid this prof if you can

Chester is very knowledgeable of the subject but the tests are all write out (compared to multiple choice in other classes) and are pretty difficult if you don't know everything about the topic. He has occasional in class assignments that are his way of taking role. If you are not there for 2 of them, he takes off credit for attendance.

Dr. Chester is a very caring professor with a great personality, and he actually made the subject pretty interesting to me, but he is much harder than other professors for a class like this. The tests were very difficult (all diagrams and write outs, no multiple choice), and there were only 3 (2 midterms and a final) which I hate.

Dr. Chester makes Geology 104 WAY too difficult. I had to Q drop & now I'm chaining majors. He makes his tests are insane. There's only 2 tests & they are all free response. You're expected to reproduce many diagrams & he will flip them on the test to confuse you. He would go off on tangents so you don't know what info was needed. DO NOT TAKE HIM.

DO NOT TAKE CHESTER. He makes his exams too difficult, he has too much time on his hands and creates paragraph long questions, charts, and diagram questions. VERY SPECIFIC QUESTIONS. WORST PROFESSOR I EVER TOOK. HE IS VERY DISCOURAGING AS WELL, he tells students they will do bad and that his exams will be hard! NO CURVES

He is very difficult. This is supposed to be an intro class and I know of many freshmen geology majors that are changing their majors because this class scared them out of it. He is extremely difficult and the only people who do well are the petroleum engineers who have a year under their belt. Not recommended for freshmen at all.

Dr. Chester makes his class extremely difficult when it doesn't have to be. There are 2 exams and a final. Each exam has 10 short answer/drawing diagram questions that are extremely specific and difficult to answer. I had to Q drop the class. If you can, TAKE EVERRETT. Their exams were 20 m/c A B or C questions. It'll make a huge difference in GPA

Chester is an extremely difficult professor.  His tests are impossible.  It is all replicating a bunch of different diagrams that he'll try and squeeze into one half page question and then short essay questions. His tests are extremely specific as well and you have to know every little detail.  If you can take a different prof over him DO IT.

Chester gives the MOST difficult tests, very unnecessary and they are too in-depth for an intro class. He expects you to basically know every little detail and process and gets a little too creative with diagrams, charts, and tables on tests. Worst class I ever took in college, he needs to go write a geology book if he's so passionate.
